title: Egyptian government pumps water out from beneath the Giza Plateau

tellings.quote: Yeah, so there's actually pumps >> that have been installed near the Valley Temple. So, the Khafre Valley Temple near the Sphinx enclosure, um the Egyptian government has installed pumps to try and pump this water out from below the Giza Plateau.

plain: The Egyptian government has installed pumps near the Khafre Valley Temple, beside the Sphinx enclosure, to pump water out from beneath the Giza Plateau. A researcher named Jeffrey Drum tells Michels this without naming a source, in a talk about what he calls an energy grid beneath the pyramids, where the water matters to his idea.
